About the artist

Between the image
and the object.

James Jared Taylor is an American artist whose practice moves between painting and sculpture. Trained in sculpture and metal fabrication, he brings a construction-minded approach to images, materials, and space. After decades of living and teaching in Southern California, he relocated to Oregon in 2025, where he continues to work in both visual art and music.
